Trump Praises AI as Revolution, Warns Against China

US President Donald Trump described Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a revolution larger than the internet, stating that whoever wins in AI will rule. He also shared an AI-generated video depicting a clash with a hockey stick. Trump asserted that the US cannot fall behind China in this domain. Regarding data centers, he claimed their approval would bring significant revenue, lower taxes, and increase property values, while opposition would lead to poverty and backwardness.
